long_description: CRC Maesta is a super-premium, under-construction residential development located in the ultra-prime Sector 1, Noida Extension (Greater Noida West). Spanning approximately 3.6 acres of land, this high-end gated community features 5 iconic high-rise towers soaring up to G+33 floors, housing a total of only 358 exclusive residences. Designed for buyers who demand absolute privacy and spaciousness, the project represents the lowest-density development in the region, offering only 2 apartments per floor. Built to high specifications, Maesta offers grand 3 BHK and 4 BHK layouts, each providing 270-degree panoramic green views.
